llm.reasoningSource: API declarations come from this catalog query. The allowed list is a local calling policy and can be edited. Refreshing preserves existing settings; a model test does not prove that an effort took effect.
llm.effortsUnknown: API effort levels: unknown. The catalog has not been queried or the API did not provide levels. Query the catalog or enter levels from the API documentation.
llm.effortsUnsupported: The API declares no available effort levels. This does not mean the model cannot reason. Check the API documentation before overriding manually.
llm.effortsPlaceholder: Enter comma-separated levels from the API documentation
llm.effortsRequired: Enter at least one allowed effort for {name}, or disable effort parameter control.
llm.metaEffortUnsupported: Effort levels: API declares none available
llm.apiDefaultHint: API default omits the effort parameter and may still allow reasoning. The explicit value none is a separate level and requires API/model support.
llm.title: Language models
llm.description: Share model connections with plugins and their Sidecars. API keys are stored in Windows Credential Manager.
llm.templateDescription: Choose a template to prefill the API format and base URL, then enter your API key and add a model. All fields remain editable.
llm.noConnections: Add an API connection or a local OpenAI-compatible server.
llm.name: Name
llm.inspectDescription: API check reads the model catalog using the current fields, including an unsaved key. Save settings to keep your changes.
llm.partialCatalog: This is a partial catalog. You can enter other model IDs manually.
llm.allowImages: Allow image input (requires a vision-capable model; selected images are sent to this API)
llm.claudeReasoning: Claude's official OpenAI-compatible endpoint ignores reasoning_effort. Keep this disabled for that connection.
llm.reasoningDescription: Plugins receive the local allowed list and inherit the default. Disabling this only omits effort parameters; it does not turn reasoning off. Follow the provider's semantics to disable reasoning. The value none is never added automatically.
llm.noPlugins: No plugins are registered. Enable the plugins you want to use first.
llm.permissionDescription: Access also applies to the plugin's native Sidecars. Plugins must declare rpc:llm.
llm.saveBeforeTest: Save the connection, key and model settings before testing generation.
llm.testDescription: Save before testing. A test sends a small request to your configured service.
llm.connectionInUse: Remove or reassign the models using this connection first.
llm.keySaved: A key is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
llm.keyMissing: No key saved. Local HTTP servers may use no key.
llm.metadataUnavailable: Capability metadata is unavailable or not recognized
llm.preset_deepseek: Uses the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API. Enter a model ID available in your DeepSeek account.
llm.preset_openai: Uses the Responses API. Enter a model ID available in your OpenAI API project.
llm.preset_gemini: Uses the official OpenAI-compatible endpoint with a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio.
llm.preset_claude: Uses the official OpenAI-compatible endpoint with a workspace-scoped API key from Claude Console.
llm.preset_siliconflow: Uses the SiliconFlow China endpoint. Enter the full model ID from your platform console, including its provider prefix.
llm.catalogUnsupported: The models endpoint is unavailable (HTTP {status}). Authentication and model access have not been verified; enter a model ID manually and test a saved model.
llm.catalogReceived: Model catalog received · {count} models · {ms} ms. Generation access requires a model test.
llm.catalogMatches: {count} matches; showing up to 100. Capabilities are API declarations and may initialize new profiles. Existing effort settings change only when applied. Missing fields remain unknown.
llm.testNoText: Request completed in {ms} ms without visible text (finish: {finish}). Text output has not been verified.
llm.modelPlaceholder: Model identifier supplied by your API service
